facts.text: John and his family have noticed increased energy and improvements in strength and endurance since starting to work out together.

evidence.quote: Yeah Maria! We've had lots more energy and noticed some gains in strength and endurance.

facts.text: John and his family work out together three times a week.

evidence.quote: Three times a week; it keeps us on track.

facts.text: John and his family are motivated to create healthy habits and are supporting each other in their fitness journey.

evidence.quote: We're pushing ourselves and supporting each other which is super motivating.
Seeing that kind of dedication is inspiring! Keep it up!

facts.text: John's children are excited about staying active and participating in family workouts.

evidence.quote: Best of all, my kids are getting excited about staying active!
